about: Hand-labelled cases written by the developer (with Claude Code), NOT by the model under test (Gemini). They target two weaknesses seen in a dry run over the practice tickets: English/German tickets labelled as Dutch, and FAQ-covered integration questions being escalated. Labels follow the brief and docs/faq.md. priority is null where the brief leaves room for judgement; null fields are not scored. Dutch/German bodies have an English gloss.

cases.subject: URGENT clock-in broken
cases.body: URGENT: since 07:30 none of the staff in our two cafés in Utrecht can clock in. The app just shows a spinning wheel. Breakfast service starts at 8.

label.reason: English. Many users blocked right now: P1, needs a human.

cases.subject: Invoice
cases.body: Hi, quick one: where do I download last month's invoice? Our bookkeeper in Zwolle needs it. Thanks, Pieter

cases.subject: AFAS
cases.body: We have the Basis plan. Can Roosterly send our approved hours to AFAS?

label.reason: English. F04 answers it: AFAS export exists and is part of the Plus plan.

cases.subject: Uren naar AFAS
cases.gloss: Can Roosterly send our approved hours to AFAS? We have Basis.
cases.body: Kan Roosterly onze goedgekeurde uren naar AFAS sturen? We hebben Basis.

label.reason: Dutch. F04 answers it: AFAS export exists and is part of the Plus plan.

cases.subject: Falsche Schichten
cases.gloss: Since this morning the app shows wrong shifts for all employees in Venlo. Please check urgently.
cases.body: Seit heute Morgen zeigt die App bei allen Mitarbeitern in Venlo falsche Schichten an. Bitte dringend prüfen.

label.reason: German bug report not covered by the FAQ: human.

cases.subject: Untranslated button
cases.body: The Dutch word 'Uitnodigen' on the invite button is not translated in the English app. Minor thing.

label.reason: English cosmetic bug, not in the FAQ: human, no urgency.

cases.subject: Export Loket
cases.gloss: We use Loket.nl. Can I export the hours per month?
cases.body: Wij gebruiken Loket.nl. Kan ik de uren per maand exporteren?

label.reason: Dutch. F04: exports to Loket.nl run per pay period (week, four weeks or month); Plus plan.

cases.subject: Login trouble
cases.body: Morning team, I forgot my password and the reset email never arrived. What now? Regards, Sanne

label.reason: English. F01 covers it, including checking the spam folder.
